svg.title: Storage topology: songnodes medallion tables
svg.desc: 9 stores with their writers (arrows in) and readers (arrows out). Cards with a padlock name their lock, lease or unique-key rule.

g.aria-label: songnodes Postgres 18 (sn-be-store-postgres) – postgres at compose service postgres, volume songnodes-dev_dev-postgres-18 (not published); owner rest-api, worker, unified-scraper, graph-api; concurrency: row locks: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED on ingestion_jobs and target_tracks; FOR UPDATE on bronze/silver playlist during ingest; outbox ordered by (txid,id) below pg_snapshot_xmin
g.title: songnodes Postgres 18 (sn-be-store-postgres) – postgres at compose service postgres, volume songnodes-dev_dev-postgres-18 (not published); owner rest-api, worker, unified-scraper, graph-api; concurrency: row locks: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED on ingestion_jobs and target_tracks; FOR UPDATE on bronze/silver playlist during ingest; outbox ordered by (txid,id) below pg_snapshot_xmin

g.aria-label: bronze_scraped_playlists +2 (sn-be-tbl-bronze) – postgres at public schema (medallion 001); owner unified-scraper persistence pipeline; rest-api import-tracklist; concurrency: upsert on source keys; per-row savepoints; bronze_incomplete marker
g.title: bronze_scraped_playlists +2 (sn-be-tbl-bronze) – postgres at public schema (medallion 001); owner unified-scraper persistence pipeline; rest-api import-tracklist; concurrency: upsert on source keys; per-row savepoints; bronze_incomplete marker

g.aria-label: bronze_api_enrichments (sn-be-tbl-bronze-api-enrichments) – postgres at medallion 001; owner none; concurrency: none
g.title: bronze_api_enrichments (sn-be-tbl-bronze-api-enrichments) – postgres at medallion 001; owner none; concurrency: none

g.aria-label: gold_track_analytics +2 (sn-be-tbl-gold-analytics) – postgres at medallion 003 (not applied by compose); owner data-transformer and gold_layer_processor (not deployed); concurrency: n/a
g.title: gold_track_analytics +2 (sn-be-tbl-gold-analytics) – postgres at medallion 003 (not applied by compose); owner data-transformer and gold_layer_processor (not deployed); concurrency: n/a

g.aria-label: gold_track_graph (sn-be-tbl-gold-track-graph) – postgres at medallion 006; owner created at init; refreshed only by restore_and_promote.sh and remove_same_artist_edges.sql; concurrency: REFRESH CONCURRENTLY needs migration 008 unique index, which compose does not apply
g.title: gold_track_graph (sn-be-tbl-gold-track-graph) – postgres at medallion 006; owner created at init; refreshed only by restore_and_promote.sh and remove_same_artist_edges.sql; concurrency: REFRESH CONCURRENTLY needs migration 008 unique index, which compose does not apply

g.aria-label: outbox_events +2 (sn-be-tbl-outbox) – postgres at migration 014, 220; owner every catalog write in the same transaction; concurrency: at-least-once; handler+offset in one transaction; 3 in-process attempts then dead letter; rebase_after_restore for txid reset
g.title: outbox_events +2 (sn-be-tbl-outbox) – postgres at migration 014, 220; owner every catalog write in the same transaction; concurrency: at-least-once; handler+offset in one transaction; 3 in-process attempts then dead letter; rebase_after_restore for txid reset

g.aria-label: projection_tracks (sn-be-tbl-projection-tracks) – postgres at migration 014; owner worker projection_consume / rebuild; concurrency: outbox consumer projection_tracks; keyed upserts; reconcile job
g.title: projection_tracks (sn-be-tbl-projection-tracks) – postgres at migration 014; owner worker projection_consume / rebuild; concurrency: outbox consumer projection_tracks; keyed upserts; reconcile job

g.aria-label: silver_enriched_tracks +6 (sn-be-tbl-silver) – postgres at medallion 002, 006, migration 014, 270; owner worker datalayer (ingest, evidence, identity); also scraper persistence pipeline and rest-api catalog writes; concurrency: transitions ON CONFLICT (from_track_id,to_track_id); silver_enriched_tracks has no unique key (lookup-then-insert in upsert_track)
g.title: silver_enriched_tracks +6 (sn-be-tbl-silver) – postgres at medallion 002, 006, migration 014, 270; owner worker datalayer (ingest, evidence, identity); also scraper persistence pipeline and rest-api catalog writes; concurrency: transitions ON CONFLICT (from_track_id,to_track_id); silver_enriched_tracks has no unique key (lookup-then-insert in upsert_track)

g.aria-label: song_adjacency (sn-be-tbl-song-adjacency) – postgres at only in sql/init/05 and scrapers/music_schema.sql (not applied); owner scraper persistence pipeline; concurrency: n/a
g.title: song_adjacency (sn-be-tbl-song-adjacency) – postgres at only in sql/init/05 and scrapers/music_schema.sql (not applied); owner scraper persistence pipeline; concurrency: n/a

g.text: Badge = flow numbers (none: reader listed on the store)
Lock, lease or unique key (word in the card)
